title: Ridgeline Warranty Coverage Crew Labor Standard by Installation Method
content:
Labor on a Warranty Coverage technician visit is done by the crew the openings need, set by the method of the installation job that installed them, as the Installation Jobs records show it:

| Installation method of the job | Technicians doing the labor | Labor crew rate |
|---|---|---|
| Bay and Bow Installation | three | 3.0 (three-technician labor crew rate) |
| Full-Frame Installation with Exterior Trim Wrap | two | 2.0 (two-technician labor crew rate) |
| Masonry Opening Installation | two | 2.0 (two-technician labor crew rate) |
| any other method | — | no labor crew rate |

In clause form: labor on openings whose installation job used the Bay and Bow Installation method is done by three technicians and takes the three-technician labor crew rate; labor on openings whose job used the Full-Frame Installation with Exterior Trim Wrap method or the Masonry Opening Installation method is done by two technicians and takes the two-technician labor crew rate; labor on openings installed by any other method takes no labor crew rate.

## Points of judgement

- The installation job is the one recorded on the Warranty Coverage registration.
- Insert Pocket Installation, Full-Frame Installation without trim wrap and Door System Installation take no labor crew rate.
